articles.title: The oil shock is testing private credit borrowers already burdened by high debt costs
articles.description: Oil near $100 could further squeeze leveraged private credit borrowers as investors weigh the risk that inflation could push interest rates higher again.

articles.title: Bitcoin recovers toward $77,300 as zcash leverage unwinds
articles.description: Bitcoin rose 0.7% since midnight UTC to around $77,200, and 68 of the CoinDesk 100 constituents gained, though the index remains 1.4% lower over 24 hours.

articles.title: Treasury yields steady as traders await consumer inflation data amid oil price pressure
articles.description: Treasurys steadied Friday after surging to multiyear highs, as investors await more economic data.

articles.title: Standard Chartered forecasts SKY rising fivefold to $0.325 by 2028
articles.description: The bank expects Sky to pass five times as much value to token holders by 2028 as USDS adoption and borrowing capacity continue to expand.

articles.title: India launches tokenized bond pilot with $107M issued
articles.description: SEBI said later phases of Demat 2.0 will introduce secondary trading and open the tokenized bonds to retail investors.

articles.title: Bitcoin pulls back as another golden cross fails to deliver

articles.title: Albuquerque Bans Bitcoin ATMs, Giving Operators 45 Days to Remove Them
articles.description: A councilor said 90% of crypto kiosk transactions in the city are tied to fraud, calling the machines a conduit for crime.

articles.title: Bessent says 'a large bank' will be sanctioned on Monday as part of Iran strategy

articles.title: Further European rate hikes 'very much dependent' on energy costs, Bundesbank chief tells CNBC

articles.title: Sam Bankman-Fried Asks Supreme Court to Overturn FTX Fraud Conviction

articles.title: Bitwise to put down Dogecoin ETF less than a year after launch

articles.title: Jamie Dimon joins bankers lobbying the UK ahead of its critical budget — here’s why they’re worried

articles.title: China's wealthy brace for a widening tax net as Beijing closes in
